*

title: Assistant Manager - Trade Operations
description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.


This position is in our Ag \& Trading enterprise, where we connect producers and users of grains and oilseeds around the globe through origination, trading, processing, and distribution. We also offer a range of farmer services and risk management solutions.

**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

  

The responsibility of this position is to ensure the efficiency in Export\-Import of commodities from all the major \& minor seaports and across the world. This role requires the individual to coordinate Export\- Import Documentation (Containers \& Bulk) Shipping Lines, Customs \& Other Govt bodies, operations processes, Customer service and quality management. Achieving operations efficiency to the highest possible standard and meeting the company's expectations.

  

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


* Ensure that the end\-to\-end Trade Execution processes are executed flawlessly, involving contracts management, plan, execution and finalization the shipment. The operational lapses are minimized/ managed.
* Maintains and develops relationships with small\-size customers, suppliers and other business partners
* Collaborate with trade execution teams in other regions as necessary.
* Follows up on new contracts with routine customers in reference to quality, quantity, origin, delivery period and schedule, payments, and pricing.
* With oversight, actively works directly with traders to ensure smooth execution
* With frequent direction, communicates with agents on estimated time of arrival and any foreseen issues/concerns.
* May communicate with ocean transportation to make adjustments to the voyage of vessels
* With frequent direction, searches for opportunities to optimize planned costs and any other cost saving opportunities and analyze unexpected costs to identify root causes and define action plan.
* May conduct routine risk analysis on execution plans/contracts to provide recommendation for next steps.
* Under direct supervision, participate in process improvement analysis to search for process efficiency opportunities and deliver data driven recommendations
* Build and maintain relationships with strategic stakeholders internally and externally and leverage client interactions and business partnerships to ensure the execution of the related activities and processes.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**
------------------

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Degree in any field (preferably In Internal Business or Export/Import Documentation)
* Fluent in both written and spoken English
* Computer proficiency – Analytical tools,PowerBI MS Office (word/excel/Power Point etc.),
* Minimum 6\-8 Years of exp in the Field of Supply Chain, Shipping \& Documentation.
* Strong communication skills/soft skills.
* Good working attitude, positive approach.
* Flexible and adaptive to changing conditions in the business/markets/industry.
* Have ability to work with the team
* Effective decision making and problem\-solving skills.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Experience in handling border trade execution(Nepal/Bangladesh)**
* Knowledge of import and export regulations in India (other countries is an added advantage).
* Knowledge regarding vessel handling and discharge operations
* Knowledge in grains and other Agri commodities handling/conditions
* Knowledge in cost and warehouse management

title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
The **Role**

This is not a routine policy\-processing or supervisory role.

The Operations Lead will own the complete operational lifecycle across policy issuance,

endorsements, cancellations, SLA/TAT, dealer support, insurer coordination, operational

escalations, team productivity and technology\-enabled process automation.

The person will lead the L2 Operations function and work closely with Sales, Finance, Product

and Technology teams to ensure that operational issues do not become business bottlenecks.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on operator, problem solver and process owner who can

manage people, processes, partners and technology together.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Motor Insurance Operations

Own day\-to\-day execution and quality of:

**New Motor Policy Issuance**

**Renewals**

**Endorsements**

**Cancellations**

**Policy corrections**

**Break\-in cases**

**Inspection coordination**

**Documentation and verification**

**Premium / coverage / add\-on validation**

**Policy servicing and related operational requests**

Ensure accuracy, compliance, productivity and SLA adherence across the complete process.

2\. SLA \& Operations Management

Own operational SLA/TAT from case initiation to closure.

Monitor real\-time operational performance and pending cases.

Identify SLA risks and intervene before they become escalations.

Track SLA performance across insurers, portals, dealers, regions and business channels.

Establish structured reason, category and sub\-category classification for operational

exceptions.

Conduct RCA for SLA breaches and recurring operational issues.

Drive corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain operational dashboards and performance reviews.

Ensure consistent SLA adherence across the L2 function.

The expectation is to prevent SLA breaches—not simply report them.

3\. Technology\-Enabled Operations \& Automation

Lead the evolution of a technology\-enabled insurance operations model.

Drive adoption and optimization of AI/ML\-enabled and intelligent workflow solutions

across policy issuance and servicing.

Identify repetitive, high\-volume and error\-prone processes for automation.

Work with Product \& Technology teams to convert operational requirements into

scalable solutions.

Monitor automation effectiveness, processing accuracy and operational throughput.

Analyse exceptions and recurring failure patterns and drive resolution.

Continuously reduce manual dependency and operational turnaround time.

Ensure appropriate operational fallback processes for technology or system exceptions.

The goal: faster processing, higher accuracy, lower operational dependency and scalable

growth.

4\. Insurer, Aggregator \& Portal Management

Act as the operational SPOC for insurers, aggregators and external operational partners.

Coordinate with insurers and aggregators for issuance, servicing and escalation matters.

Manage insurer/portal\-related operational issues.

Maintain appropriate redundancy and fallback processes for critical operational

dependencies.

Track insurer\-wise operational performance and SLA.

Ensure timely escalation and closure of unresolved issues.

Work with Technology/Product teams to address recurring portal/process issues.

5\. Dealer \& Sales Operations Support

Own Operations as a focal point for Sales and Dealer support.

Resolve dealer operational queries and escalations.

Support Sales on issuance, endorsement, cancellation and servicing requirements.

Define and maintain Sales–Operations escalation processes and response SLAs.

Ensure dealer issues are tracked through closure.

Identify recurring dealer issues and eliminate root causes.

Work closely with Sales to ensure operational readiness for business growth.

6\. L2 Team Leadership \& Productivity

Lead the L2 Operations team and own its performance.

Allocate workload based on volume and priority.

Set individual and team productivity expectations.

Monitor workload, capacity, productivity and quality.

Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews.

Coach and develop team members.

Identify performance gaps and initiate corrective actions/PIPs where required.

Manage shift planning, leave and operational coverage.

Build a high\-accountability and high\-productivity culture.

7\. Wallet, Recharge \& Operational Reconciliation

Coordinate and own operational resolution for:

Dealer wallet/recharge issues

Recharge failures

Balance discrepancies

Policy\-to\-wallet reconciliation

Dealer payment\-related operational queries

Coordination with Finance on operational reconciliation and settlement issues

8\. MIS, Analytics \& Operational Governance

Establish a reliable Operations Control \& Reporting framework covering:

Policy volumes

SLA/TAT

Pending cases and ageing

Error/quality rates

Productivity

Insurer/portal performance

Dealer/region performance

Escalations

Root\-cause trends

Automation effectiveness

Operational exceptions  
Strong Excel / Power BI / SQL / analytical capability will be an advantage.

**Key Success Metrics**  
The candidate will be measured on measurable business outcomes, including:

* SLA/TAT adherence
* Policy issuance accuracy
* Endorsement \& cancellation TAT
* Pending\-case ageing
* Escalation resolution time
* Team productivity
* Dealer support SLA
* Insurer/partner issue resolution
* Operational error rate
* Automation\-enabled processing efficiency
* Reduction in manual intervention
* Process improvement and cost efficiency

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

**5–8 years of experience in Motor/General Insurance Operations.**

* **Strong hands\-on experience in policy issuance and servicing**
* **Good understanding of endorsements, cancellations, renewals, corrections and break\-in cases**
* **Proven experience managing SLA/TAT and high\-volume operations**
* **2–3\+ years of team\-handling/L2 management experience**
* **Experience coordinating with multiple insurers/insurance partners**
* **Strong escalation and stakeholder\-management skills**
* **Strong Excel/MIS and analytical capability**
* **Ability to identify operational bottlenecks and drive RCA/corrective action**
* **Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment**

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Deputy Manager - Operations & Maintenance CNG
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**CNG O\&M Engineer \- O4**


**Operational Support:**


* Assist in the day\-to\-day operations of CNG stations, ensuring the efficient and reliable delivery of services.
* Monitor the performance of equipment and systems, conducting routine inspections to identify and address any operational issues.
* Support the implementation of operational strategies and procedures developed by the O\&M Lead to optimize system performance and reliability.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory, safety, and environmental standards during operations, reporting any deviations to the O\&M Lead.
* Provide technical support during the integration of new systems or equipment into existing CNG infrastructure.


**Maintenance Execution:**


* Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities on CNG station equipment, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Utilize diagnostic tools and techniques to monitor the condition of CNG station infrastructure, identifying maintenance needs.
* Coordinate with contractors and service providers to carry out maintenance tasks, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs, ensuring these are readily available for review.
* Implement best practices in maintenance management, contributing to continuous improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.


**Technical Problem Solving:**


* Troubleshoot technical issues that arise during operations or maintenance activities, providing timely and effective solutions.
* Analyze system data and performance metrics to identify potential areas for improvement and to prevent future operational disruptions.
* Collaborate with the O\&M Lead to develop and implement engineering solutions that enhance the reliability and efficiency of CNG systems.
* Participate in technical meetings and reviews, offering insights and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.


**Safety and Compliance:**


* Ensure all maintenance and operational activities comply with safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
* Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
* Assist in the development of safety protocols and procedures, ensuring they are adhered to by all team members and contractors.
* Prepare safety documentation, such as risk assessments and method statements, to support safe operations and maintenance practices.


**Documentation and Reporting:**


* Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including maintenance logs, inspection reports, and equipment manuals.
* Provide regular updates to the O\&M Lead on the status of ongoing maintenance activities and any issues encountered.
* Assist in the preparation of operational and maintenance reports for senior management, highlighting key findings and areas for improvement.
* Ensure that all documentation is organized, accessible, and complies with internal and external audit requirements.


**Team Collaboration and Communication:**


* Work closely with other engineers, technicians, and team members to ensure smooth execution of maintenance and operational activities.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure that project objectives and timelines are met.
* Participate in team meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on improving operational efficiency.
* Liaise with other departments as needed to ensure integrated and effective operations of CNG stations.


**Continuous Improvement and Learning:**


* Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to CNG operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance performance.
* Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth within the team.
* Share knowledge and insights with the team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.


**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**


**Internal Stakeholders:**


* Regional office
* Corporate office
* TechnoCommercial Team
* HSE Team
* Projects


**External Stakeholders:**


* Vendors
* Contractors
* Local authorities
* Regulatory bodies
* Consultants

### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**



Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.


**Work Experience:**



4\+ years of experience in gas station construction operations and maintenance


**Preferred Industry:**



Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.

title: Global L&D Operations Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


Our Global Learning \& Development (L\&D) Operations function is a key enabler of our firm’s success, ensuring learning programs are delivered with quality, consistency, and scalability across regions and cohorts.


You will lead a team of operations professionals and ensure effective, scalable execution of learning processes, including learner lifecycle management, system integrity, capacity planning, and operational excellence aligned to global L\&D priorities.

 **Responsibilities**

* Manage LMS operations and end\-to\-end learner lifecycle
* Allocate resources and manage capacity planning
* Ensure SLA adherence, KPI performance, and data accuracy
* Act as escalation point for operational and system issues
* Improve workflows and enhance system efficiency
* Coach and develop team members
* Maintain system \& data integrity and reporting quality

  

What You'll Bring

* 6\+ years of relevant experience in L\&D operations, systems, program management, or service environments
* Proven experience managing operational processes, learner lifecycle, or system\-driven workflows
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop individuals or small teams in operational environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations and ensure process alignment
* Experience working with systems (e.g., LMS) and ensuring data accuracy and process compliance
* Strong organizational and planning skills, including capacity and workload management
* Continuous improvement mindset focused on efficiency, scalability, and operational excellence

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work with global L\&D teams, business stakeholders, faculty, vendors, and cross\-functional partners to deliver and continuously improve learning experiences.

  

Additional info

**You’re Good At**

* Managing systems, workflows, and operational processes including LMS
* Ensuring data accuracy, governance and adherence to SLAs
* Handling operational escalations effectively
* Driving efficiency and consistency
* Balancing capacity and demand
* Developing team capability

  

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.


For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.


We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
